summary.text: Humans alike dragons is Duke Long's Gu refinement method that uses a Gu Immortal as material with raging wave rising dragon fire to turn a human into a dragonman.

claims.text: Bai Xiang heavenly spirit tells Bai Ning Bing that a Gu refinement method uses the Gu Immortal as Gu material together with raging wave rising dragon fire, so the user leaves the human race and becomes a dragonman. The spirit names Duke Long, a Heavenly Court Gu Immortal, as the creator: he brought the method of humans alike dragons, fused refinement path and transformation path, and made the dragonman race, originally to prolong lifespan.

The spirit names it the humans alike dragons Gu refinement method and says it is dangerous. Gu refinement has strict requirements toward materials and dao marks. This method uses the Gu Immortal themselves as the immortal material, and every Gu Immortal has different numbers of dao marks of differing paths, so the success chance is low. Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance Physique, or transformation path or refinement path cultivation, would raise the chance. Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique sits at the opposite extreme. During refinement, all dao marks are affected, and ice and snow path dao marks might vanish completely. Bai Ning Bing chooses the method at once, hoping other unwanted dao marks will vanish with them.
Duke Long awakens in Heavenly Court’s immortal graveyard after smelling fate, and tells Fairy Zi Wei’s group that he sensed someone using the humans alike dragons Gu refinement method.

During the process Bai Ning Bing realizes the method targets not only raging wave rising dragon fire but also himself. Body, soul, and the dao marks in his body are melted and separated under the refinement.

The method reaches its final crucial moment. In history, Gu Masters or Gu Immortals who tried to turn into dragonmen were extremely careful and made ample preparations. Bai Ning Bing’s situation is much worse, yet the refinement succeeds and restores immortal status. The spirit explains that the result depends on the proportion and mix of immortal materials, and that earlier transformation path dao marks influenced the product, turning the body into a dragon lady rather than a strictly controlled outcome.
Ying Wu Xie concludes that Bai Ning Bing used the humans alike dragons Gu refinement method, calling it a method long lost, and is shocked that Bai Xiang grotto-heaven still had it.

Ying Wu Xie asks how Bai Xiang heavenly spirit still had the method when Duke Long had supposedly eliminated it. He also says that only someone who has used the humans alike dragons Gu refinement method to become a dragonman Gu Immortal can inherit Immortal Gu House Dragon Palace.

Fang Yuan obtains Bai Ning Bing’s dragonman transformation method and names it the humans alike dragons Gu refinement method: the Gu Immortal is refined with raging wave rising dragon fire and the race changes into a dragonman. Success rate is minute, and all dao marks are affected. He judges that Duke Long created it while proficient in qi path and transformation path, without deep refinement path attainment, mostly relying on qi path and transformation path to imitate refinement path. Fang Yuan improves the refinement path aspect and raises the success chance toward about ten percent. He also states that the method is essentially a human path killer move that involves transformation path profundities, and that it is a supreme material for comprehending human path essence.

Heavenly Court talk restates that humans alike dragons was the Gu refinement method created by Duke Long, that it could turn humans into dragonmen, and that the first generation dragonmen were created by this method. Heavenly Court holds Duke Long’s information and the method, which helps them deduce part of Wu Shuai’s foundation.
